name: miyagi-vscode
displayName: Miyagi: learn while your AI codes
description: A side panel that watches what your AI assistant builds and teaches you the few ideas worth owning, without touching the assistant's work.
author: George M'sapenda

commands.title: Teach Me a Branch or Pull Request
Tour the Ideas in This Codebase
Share My Progress with My Team
Turn On Command Capture (choose assistant and scope)
Move Panel to Another Side Bar

miyagi.watch.enabled.description: Watch the workspace for code changes and add a lesson card when a change uses an idea worth understanding. Read-only: uses git diff and never edits files.

miyagi.watch.ignore.markdownDescription: Files Miyagi should never teach from, as glob patterns relative to the repository. A pattern with no slash matches at any depth, like a `.gitignore` line. Examples: `**/*.test.ts`, `migrations/**`, `*.generated.*`.

miyagi.watch.excludeRepositories.description: Repositories to leave alone, by folder name or full path. Useful when one window holds several projects and only some are yours to learn.

enumDescriptions: Hold new cards until a commit, a test run, or a pause in the work.
Show a card as soon as a change is read.
miyagi.watch.teachAt.description: When a change becomes a card. A card that arrives mid-task interrupts the task and is read by nobody, so by default Miyagi waits for a stopping point.

miyagi.watch.quietSeconds.description: With teaching at breakpoints: how many seconds without a change count as a pause.

miyagi.ideasPerChange.description: The most ideas taught from one change. The rest are named and left for next time.

miyagi.recallFirst.description: Show a question without its choices first. You answer in your head, tap how sure you are, and then the choices appear. Recalling an answer teaches more than recognising it.

miyagi.explainFirst.description: "Explain in my code" asks what you think the lines do before showing an explanation, with a nudge and a pointer on the way. "Skip, just show me" is always there.

miyagi.fadeSupport.description: From green belt up, show an idea's question first and keep its lesson behind a link.

miyagi.mixTopicsInReview.description: With a topic chosen, still take about one review question in four from another topic. Mixed questions are harder and are remembered longer.

miyagi.blackBeltNeedsTransfer.description: Before an idea reaches black belt, ask one question about it in a different language or framework. Needs an AI; without one this is skipped.

miyagi.weeklyGoalDays.description: How many days a week you aim to practise. Miyagi shows progress toward this instead of a daily streak, and a week that falls one day short still counts.

miyagi.reviewAfterFirstCommit.description: After your first commit of the day, offer up to three review questions. Once a day, and only if something is due.

enumDescriptions: Nothing. New cards wait in the panel.
A count on the Miyagi icon.
A count on the icon and a notification naming the idea.
miyagi.notify.description: How you are told about a new card while the panel is not showing.

enumDescriptions: Never remind me.
At most once a day, when three or more questions are due.
miyagi.reviewReminder.description: Whether Miyagi reminds you that review questions are due.

miyagi.quietHours.markdownDescription: A daily time range with no cards, notifications or reminders, as `HH:MM-HH:MM` in 24-hour time. `22:00-07:00` crosses midnight. Empty means none. Changes are still read during quiet hours so nothing is taught late.

miyagi.statusBar.description: Show Miyagi in the status bar, with the number of questions due.

enumDescriptions: Use the assistant you were seen working with, else the first one found.
Chat models the editor exposes to extensions (GitHub Copilot in VS Code).
Claude Code, run headless on your existing login.
OpenAI Codex, run headless on your existing login.
Gemini CLI, run headless on your existing login.
A model running on this machine through Ollama. Nothing leaves it.
Your own command (miyagi.ai.customCommand).
No AI. Cards use the built-in lessons only.
miyagi.ai.provider.description: Which AI writes the explanation tied to your code. It runs on your own account with that provider; Miyagi has no account and no key of its own.

miyagi.ai.model.description: Model to ask for. Empty picks a small, cheap model where the provider lets Miyagi choose (Claude Code: haiku; Ollama: the first model you have pulled).

miyagi.ai.customCommand.markdownDescription: A shell command that reads the prompt on stdin and prints the answer on stdout, for example `llm -m gpt-4o-mini` or `ollama run llama3.2`. Used when the provider is `custom`.

miyagi.ai.ollamaUrl.description: Where your Ollama server listens. Empty stops Miyagi from looking for one.

enumDescriptions: Only when you press "Explain in my code" on a card.
Automatically for every new card. Uses more of your AI allowance.
miyagi.ai.explain.description: When Miyagi asks your AI for an explanation.

enumDescriptions: Only the built-in ideas and your idea packs are taught.
Ask your AI what is worth understanding when a change matches none of the built-in ideas.
Ask your AI about every change, as well as the built-in ideas.
miyagi.ai.findIdeas.markdownDescription: Let your AI find ideas the built-in list does not know. This runs **without a button press** and uses your AI allowance, so it is off by default and limited by `miyagi.ai.findIdeasPerHour`. Lessons it writes are marked as written by your AI.

miyagi.ai.findIdeasPerHour.description: The most times per hour Miyagi may ask your AI to look for ideas in a change.

miyagi.voice.autoRead.description: Read new cards, explanations and walkthrough steps aloud using your system's speech engine.

miyagi.team.folder.description: Where team summaries are written and read, relative to the repository. Sharing happens when you commit the file; Miyagi sends nothing anywhere.

miyagi.team.name.description: The name on the summary you share with your team.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --baseContentUrl https://github.com/c00p75/miyagi/blob/main/vscode --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/c00p75/miyagi/raw/main/vscode
scripts.release: npm run package && npm run publish:marketplace && npm run publish:openvsx
scripts.harness: mkdir -p dist-test/harness && esbuild test/harness/mock.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-test/harness/mock.cjs --log-level=error --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent && node dist-test/harness/mock.cjs dist-test/harness/mock.js && cp test/harness/index.html media/panel.css media/panel.js dist-test/harness/ && echo "Serving on http://localhost:8765/index.html#feed" && python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory dist-test/harness
